name: 60505 · Aurora, IL
findings: ZIP 60505 (Aurora) has 114 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60505 (Aurora) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60505 (Aurora) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
